animations.name: bulge
animations.css: @keyframes bulge { 0% { transform: scale(1) } 50% { transform: scale(1.25) } to { transform: scale(1) } }
animations.description: Pulsing scale animation used for shopping bag icon feedback when items are added.

animations.name: bag-animation
animations.description: Applied to bag icon with a transform-origin of 32.5% for add-to-cart visual feedback.

animations.name: spinner-load
animations.description: Continuous 360-degree rotation for loading spinner indicators.

animations.name: marquee-scroll
animations.css: @keyframes _mrq-scroll_tykyq_1 { 0% { transform: translate(0,0) } to { transform: translate3d(calc(-100% / var(--mrq-copies)), 0, 0) } }
animations.description: Horizontal scrolling animation for marquee/ticker content with CSS variable-driven distance.

animations.name: global-transition
animations.description: Standard transition for background color changes across the site, used on navigation and interactive elements.

animations.name: add-to-cart-scale
animations.description: Combined transform and opacity transition for add-to-cart button interactions with scale hover effect.

animations.name: slider-transition
animations.description: CSS variable-driven horizontal slide transition for image sliders and carousels.

animations.name: bag-overlay-reveal
animations.description: Vertical slide-in transition for the fixed shopping bag overlay element.

insights: The design system uses viewport-width-based calculations (vw units) for nearly all sizing, creating a fully fluid and responsive layout that scales proportionally across devices.

Button styling is intentionally minimal with no border-radius, favoring sharp geometric forms that align with the brand's industrial design aesthetic. Color is used sparingly with Signal Blue (#0071BB) reserved exclusively for purchase CTAs.

Motion design is subtle and functional, with micro-interactions limited to essential feedback (cart additions, loading states) and content transitions (sliders, marquees), avoiding decorative animations.
